You are one of several READ-ONLY audit agents for the Nxeon customer-portal redesign (Phase 1 = audit only). Codebase: /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15 App Router, Prisma/Postgres, Stripe, separate worker/ process). Customer portal = app/dashboard/** + components/customer/** + components/portal/**; API under app/api/**; logic in lib/**; schema in prisma/schema.prisma.

HARD RULES: STRICTLY READ-ONLY. Do NOT edit/create/delete ANY file under /opt/nxeon, /opt/nxeon-staging or /opt/nxeon-sandbox. No build, npm, prisma, db, git-write, or service commands. Do NOT touch the live database, Stripe, or infrastructure. Do not read .env* files. Your ONLY write is your report file: /tmp/claude-0/-root/1716c7ee-ae35-4cf5-b557-9059709e07c4/scratchpad/audit-06-account-billing-support.md (Write tool). Exhaustive, factual, cite repo-relative file paths, use tables, mark uncertain items UNVERIFIED. Purpose: 'nothing gets lost' capability safety net.

EFFICIENCY: batch independent shell calls; grep/sed ranges over whole-file reads. app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx is ~900 lines — read it in ranges.

CONTEXT FROM COMPLETED SIBLING AUDITS (do not re-derive): the sidebar has 25 items in 7 groups defined in app/dashboard/layout.tsx:32-95, rendered by components/portal/Shell.tsx. /dashboard/invoices, /dashboard/affiliate and /dashboard/feedback are orphan routes with no nav entry. Billing renders invoices as a stacked section, not a tab. There is no account dropdown; the avatar is decorative and sign-out is the only top-bar account action. Team roles are enforced ONLY by canAdministerOrg in lib/team-guard.ts. Do NOT re-audit routes or navigation; audit CAPABILITIES.

YOUR AUDIT: ACCOUNT-LEVEL capability inventory. SKIP domains and email (already audited). Areas:
1. DASHBOARD HOME (app/dashboard/page.tsx + PortalHero + OnboardingChecklist): every widget, data source, conditional states (new user / has resources / attention items / promos / win-back banners / onboarding checklist steps — list all steps from lib/actions-onboarding.ts), quick actions.
2. BILLING (app/dashboard/billing/**, invoices/**): wallet balance/credits, add funds, auto-recharge, payment methods (Stripe cards, setup intents, default), subscriptions and renewals (renewalCharge), invoices (list/download PDF/HTML/pay), transactions/ledger, promo codes and gift codes (CouponField, RedeemGift; the first-month-free promo is HOSTING-ONLY, plus COMEBACK50 and a riddle credit), spend controls and hard caps, bandwidth usage view, currency display vs charge currency, VAT/tax (taxContextForUser), dunning/overdue, refunds (terminationRefundCents), sandbox top-up. Cite each API route and server action.
3. SETTINGS (app/dashboard/settings/**): profile, email change, password, 2FA, sessions, API tokens, SSH keys, notification prefs, timezone/locale/currency, delete account, integrations (Cloudflare, Discord, Claude key), preferences.
4. TEAM (app/dashboard/team/**): orgs, roles, invite flow, accept flow, what a member can and cannot actually do, ownership.
5. SUPPORT (app/dashboard/support/**): tickets (create fields, categories, priorities, attachments, replies, statuses, read tracking), the FeedbackWidget and /dashboard/feedback, the live chat AI agent (state, degraded mode), knowledge base (lib/kb-system.ts), status page.
6. ACTIVITY (app/dashboard/activity/**): what is logged (AuditLog event types — list the enum/source), what is shown, retention, and the known gap that customers see only a subset.
7. REFERRALS (refer/**), AFFILIATE (affiliate/**), PARTNER (partner/**): programs, commission/tier logic, codes, payouts, stats.
8. NOTIFICATIONS: the in-app notification bell (source model, what generates entries, mark-read), plus EVERY transactional email a customer can receive (from lib/email-templates.ts and any mailer) with its trigger.
9. AUTH & ONBOARDING: login/register/verify-email/forgot/reset flows and their steps, email-verification gating (browsing is open, buying is gated), impersonation banner, Kodely SSO (app/sso/authorize).
10. Global chrome capabilities: currency switcher, notification bell, feedback widget, terminal dock, unverified-email banner.
For each area: data models + enums; CAPABILITY TABLE (action | UI location | API route/server action | backend fn | effect | danger | state handling | reversible | notes); feature flags; role gating; gaps (backend-not-in-UI, UI stubs).
Finish by writing the report, then reply with a ~12-line summary.

# Audit 06 — Account-level capability inventory (Home, Billing, Settings, Team, Support, Activity, Referrals, Notifications, Auth, Chrome)

Read-only audit of `/opt/nxeon`. Scope: **account-level** capabilities. Domains and email intentionally excluded (audited elsewhere). Routes/navigation not re-derived (see sibling audits). All paths repo-relative to `/opt/nxeon`.

Legend for capability tables:
- **Danger**: `low` (preference/read), `med` (money/state, recoverable), `HIGH` (money moves / irreversible / destroys data).
- **Rev.**: reversible by the customer themselves.

---

## 0. Cross-cutting: models & enums used by this audit

| Model / enum | File:line | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `TicketStatus` = OPEN, ANSWERED, CUSTOMER_REPLY, CLOSED | `prisma/schema.prisma:91` | Customer UI can only write OPEN/CLOSED (`lib/actions-support.ts:167`) |
| `TicketPriority` = LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT | `prisma/schema.prisma:98` | Customer chooses at create; cannot change after |
| `Ticket` (+ `discordThreadId`) | `prisma/schema.prisma:326` | `discordThreadId` **not yet pushed to the live DB** (comment at :344) |
| `TicketMessage` (`readAt`, `editedAt`, `attachment*`) | `prisma/schema.prisma:354` | 1 attachment/message; `readAt` staff→customer only |
| `Notification` (title, body, href, readAt) | `prisma/schema.prisma:468` | No `kind`/`type` column — bell entries are untyped free text |
| `WalletTransaction` (`stripeSessionId`, `stripePaymentIntentId` unique) | `prisma/schema.prisma:883` | Uniques are the idempotency guard |
| `AuditLog` (userId?, action: String, detail?) | `prisma/schema.prisma:897` | **`action` is free TEXT, not an enum** — no canonical list exists |
| `InvoiceStatus` = OPEN, PAID, VOID, REFUNDED | `prisma/schema.prisma:1159` | |
| `Invoice` (taxCents, taxRatePercent, taxCountry, refundedCents, paidBrand/paidLast4, lineItems Json) | `prisma/schema.prisma:1166` | |
| `CouponKind` = PERCENT, FIXED_CENTS, CREDIT_CENTS | `prisma/schema.prisma:1208` | |
| `CouponScope` = ANY, TOPUP, ORDER; `CouponServiceKind` = ANY, VPS, GAME | `prisma/schema.prisma:1214`, `:1221` | |
| `Coupon` / `CouponRedemption` (`ipHash`, reservation lifecycle) | `prisma/schema.prisma:1227`, `:1255` | |
| `ReferralPartner` / `PartnerCustomer` / `PartnerCommission` | `prisma/schema.prisma:2351`, `:2374`, `:2391` | commission `status` = ACCRUED\|PAID\|VOID (String, not enum) |
| `Feedback` (kind BUG\|FEATURE, status NEW\|PLANNED\|IN_PROGRESS\|DONE\|DECLINED) | `prisma/schema.prisma:2669` | Both are Strings, not enums |
| `Organization` / `Membership` (role String: OWNER\|ADMIN\|MEMBER\|BILLING, `areas` Json) | `prisma/schema.prisma:2800`, `:2809` | `areas` is **write-only/dead** — see §4 |
| `GiftCode` | `prisma/schema.prisma:2823` | single-use, `redeemedById` |
| `ApiToken` (prefix, tokenHash, scopes[], expiresAt, revoked) | `prisma/schema.prisma:2835` | |
| `NotifyKind` / `NotifyTier` catalogue | `lib/prefs.ts` (`NOTIFY_KINDS`) | The *only* thing that decides suppressibility |
| Payout statuses PENDING\|APPROVED\|PAID\|DECLINED | `lib/affiliate.ts:35` | `AffiliatePayout` model |

---

## 1. DASHBOARD HOME — `app/dashboard/page.tsx`

### 1.1 Widgets & data sources

| Widget | Source | Conditional |
|---|---|---|
| `OnboardingChecklist` | `getOnboardingSteps()` — `lib/actions-onboarding.ts:25` | Hidden if dismissed cookie `nxeon_onboarding_done` OR all 4 steps done. Renders nothing until client mount (hydration guard) |
| `AutoRefresh` | client poll | Only when any server is PENDING/PROVISIONING/REINSTALLING/DELETING (`page.tsx:113`) |
| `PortalHero` variant=`dashboard` + "Deploy server" CTA | static | always |
| **Empty state** "Launch your first VPS" | `servers.length === 0` | replaces the entire stat/table/panel block |
| StatCard "Total servers" | `db.server.findMany({userId})` | → `/dashboard/servers` |
| StatCard "Running" | `status === "RUNNING"` count | |
| StatCard "Monthly spend" | `renewalCharge(s, prices)` summed, `totalCents / months` | tax-inclusive via `taxContextForUser(user).ratePercent`; excludes `isFree` and `DELETING` |
| StatCard "Wallet balance" | `user.balanceCents` | delta text "Add funds →" is decorative, links to `/dashboard/billing` |
| Servers table (hostname, status, plan, `PUBLIC_IP:sshPort`, Manage) | same server query | `free` badge when `isFree` |
| "Recent activity" (8) | `db.auditLog.findMany({userId}, take: 8)` | rendered via `humanizeAction` / `actionDotColor` (`components/customer/humanize.ts`) |
| "Recent transactions" (5) | `db.walletTransaction.findMany({userId}, take: 5)` | sign-coloured |

**Not present on home:** no attention/alert items (overdue renewals, card declined, bandwidth overage all live *only* on `/dashboard/billing`), no promo banners, **no win-back banner** (deploy/dormant win-back are email-only — `worker/deploy-winback.ts`, `worker/dormant-winback.ts`). Announcements/popups come from the layout, not this page.

### 1.2 Onboarding checklist — all steps (`lib/actions-onboarding.ts:44-76`)

| # | key | Label | "done" test | CTA → |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `funds` | Add funds to your wallet | `walletTransaction.count(amountCents > 0) > 0 \|\| balanceCents > 0` | `/dashboard/billing` |
| 2 | `server` | Deploy your first server | `server.count > 0` | `/dashboard/deploy` |
| 3 | `twofa` | Turn on two-factor auth | `user.totpEnabled` | `/dashboard/settings` |
| 4 | `domain` | Connect a domain | `domain.count > 0` | `/dashboard/domains` |

Order is deliberate (funds first because `payAndDeploy` refuses on an empty wallet). Step 2's description is dynamic on `addedFunds`.

| Action | UI | Backend | Effect | Danger | Rev. |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dismiss checklist | Dismiss button | `dismissOnboarding()` `lib/actions-onboarding.ts:82` | writes `nxeon_onboarding_done` cookie (1 yr, non-httpOnly) + client-side cookie | low | Only by clearing cookies — **no UI to un-dismiss** |

---

## 2. BILLING — `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx` (944 lines, single stacked page) + `app/dashboard/invoices/**`

### 2.1 Page sections in render order

1. Hero + "View & download invoices →" link
2. `?paid=1` / `?canceled=1` flash banners
3. `?card_setup=<id>` → `<CardSetupReturn>` (finalizes card)
4. **Overdue renewals panel** (red if shortfall, amber otherwise) — only if overdue servers exist
5. **Paused for non-payment** panel (SUSPENDED + `suspendReason=UNPAID`)
6. Wallet balance + `AddFunds` (+ `SandboxTopUp` when `SANDBOX`; + `CouponField` **only when Stripe is NOT configured**)
7. Payment method (card on file)
8. Refer-a-friend promo card → `/dashboard/refer`
9. Redeem a code (`RedeemGift`) | Auto-recharge (`AutoRecharge`, gated on card)
10. Billing details (`BillingProfile`) | Spend controls (`SpendControls`)
11. Monthly spend + Upcoming renewals | Transactions table (take 60)
12. Bandwidth usage
13. Invoices (take 5) + "View all"

### 2.2 Capability table

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

### What a member can *actually* do — the finding

**Nothing.** Organization membership grants **no access to any resource**. `ownedServer` (`lib/actions.ts:753`) checks `server.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "ADMIN"` and nothing else; no loader or action in `lib/` consults `Membership`. `Membership.areas` is written by nothing and read by nothing — the module docblock (`lib/team-guard.ts:8-30`) records that `requireArea` / `memberCanAccessHref` were deleted precisely because a half-wired area system is worse than none. So Team is **a roster and an invitation system, not an authorization system**. The `BILLING` role in particular implies a capability that does not exist.

**Known gaps (documented in-code):** there is no `Invitation` model, so **pending invitations cannot be listed or individually revoked**. What bounds them: 72 h TTL, binding to one email, and re-verification that the inviter still administers the org. There is also **no ownership transfer** and **no delete-organization** action.

### 7.3 `/dashboard/partner` (`app/dashboard/partner/page.tsx`)
KOL/agency lifetime-commission program. Requires `ReferralPartner.userId === user.id`; otherwise renders an explainer inviting the user to get in touch (no self-serve application form). Admin links the account in `/admin/partners`.

| Element | Source |
|---|---|
| Rate | `ReferralPartner.commissionRatePct` (default 20) — percent of the **net, pre-tax** charge |
| Attribution | `PartnerCustomer.customerId` is **UNIQUE** — one partner per customer, permanently (`attachCustomerToPartnerByCode`, `lib/partner-commission.ts:256`) |
| Accrual | `accrueCommissionForInvoice` (`:68`), `accrueRecentCommissionsForCustomer` (`:125`), `reconcilePartnerCommissions` (`:163`); `isCommissionableInvoice` (`:40`) |

| Snapshot | `baseCents`, `ratePct`, `amountCents` frozen at accrual |

| Summary | `computePartnerSummary` (`:218`) → customerCount, lifetimeCents, outstandingCents, paidCents |
| Views | Your customers (take 500, **with each customer's email address**), Recent commission (take 100) |

**Precedence rule** (`lib/actions.ts` register): an active PARTNER code wins over a peer referral code, so one `?ref=` never pays both a lifetime commission and a one-time bonus.

### 8.2 Delivery policy (`lib/prefs.ts`)

Suppressibility is decided by a message's **tier**, declared once in `NOTIFY_KINDS`, never by the call site; an unregistered kind resolves to `CRITICAL` (fails toward "delivered").

- **CRITICAL** (never suppressible, any channel): `password_reset`, `email_verify`, `security_change`, `payment_failed`, `payment_action_required`, `card_expiring`, `expiry_warning`, `suspension`, `termination`, `abuse`, `data_loss`, `fulfilment_failed`, `provision_ready`, `refund`.
- **ACCOUNT** (email suppressible via `prefs.email`; the in-app bell is always kept): `welcome`, `receipt`, `invoice`, `provision_done`, `job_done`, `domain_activity`, `support_reply`, `referral_bonus`.
- **PRODUCT** (suppressible everywhere): `product_news`.

`sendMail` is the only enforcement point; `sendTemplate` forwards `kind` (omitting it means "always send"). **`sendTemplate` currently has zero call sites** — every send goes through `sendMail` with a pre-built `emails.*` object.

## 11. Consolidated gap list

### Backend capability with no UI
1. `setTicketPriority` (`lib/actions-support.ts:175`) — customers can set priority only at creation.
2. ~20 email templates with no sender (§8.3), incl. `server_suspended`, `server_terminated`, `password_changed`, `login_alert`, `low_balance`, `referral_reward`.
3. `sendTemplate` (`lib/mailer.ts:328`) — zero call sites.
4. `Membership.areas` — written by nothing, read by nothing.
5. `Ticket.discordThreadId` — in the schema, **not pushed to the live DB**; the bridge writes it through an unchecked cast.
6. API tokens support `read`/`write` scopes but only one v1 endpoint exists (`app/api/v1/servers/route.ts`).

### UI/capability that is missing entirely
7. **No email-address change** anywhere in the portal.
8. **No session/device list** — only "sign out everywhere else".
9. **No notifications history page** — anything past the newest 15 is unreachable; no per-item read/dismiss.
10. **No promo-code entry in production** — `CouponField` is hidden whenever Stripe is configured.
11. **No customer-initiated refund or invoice-pay action** (`SettleNowButton` covers renewals only; OPEN invoices have no "Pay" button).
12. **No PDF download from the billing page's invoice list** (HTML only); PDF exists only on `/dashboard/invoices`.
13. **No org ownership transfer, no delete-organization, no pending-invite list or revoke.**
14. **No partner payout request** (affiliates have one; partners do not).
15. **No timezone / locale / per-account currency preference.**
16. **No status widget inside the portal.**
17. **No un-dismiss for the onboarding checklist.**

### Correctness / honesty risks
18. Affiliate tier amounts are marketing copy that can disagree with the actual `referral_reward_cents` credit (`lib/affiliate.ts:39`).
19. Affiliate earnings are totalled by **exact string match** on a wallet-transaction description (`REFERRAL_EARNING_DESCRIPTION`) — renaming that string silently zeroes everyone's lifetime earnings.
20. Two money-formatting conventions coexist (`fmtMoney` USD vs `formatMoney(currentCurrency())`) across billing vs affiliate/partner.
21. `Team` presents four roles (notably `BILLING`) that grant no capability at all.
22. Activity gaps (§6.2): security-relevant actions unaudited; 100-row cap; impersonation shown as a raw `actingAdmin=<cuid>` string.
23. Partner page issues one `aggregate` query per attached customer (N+1, up to 500).

Summary (12 lines):

1. **Home** — 4 stat cards, servers table, 8-row activity + 5-row transaction panels, empty state; no attention/promo/win-back banners on home at all. Onboarding checklist has exactly 4 steps (funds → server → 2FA → domain), dismissal is a 1-year cookie with no un-dismiss.
2. **Billing** is one 944-line stacked page with 13 sections. Every recurring figure routes through the single `renewalCharge` function (also used by the worker and settle path); dunning constants, grace days and auto-suspend are read from the real settings, not restated.
3. Wallet: Stripe embedded checkout (`/api/stripe/checkout` → `/api/stripe/confirm` + webhook, idempotent), demo `topUp` hard-refused in production, sandbox top-up, gift/credit-code redemption, auto-recharge (gated on a saved card), spend cap that genuinely refuses orders, VAT country/VAT-ID that genuinely drives tax.
4. **Big billing gap:** `CouponField` is hidden whenever Stripe is configured — in production there is **no promo-code entry for top-ups at all**. Also no customer-initiated refund, no "pay this invoice" button, and PDF download exists only on `/dashboard/invoices`, not on the billing page's list.
5. **Settings** has 4 `?tab=` tabs. Missing entirely: email-address change, session/device list, timezone, locale, per-account currency. `signOutOtherSessions` is the blunt substitute for a session list.
6. **Team grants no authorization whatsoever** — `ownedServer` checks only `userId`, no loader consults `Membership`, and `Membership.areas` is dead. Four roles are offered (including `BILLING`) that confer nothing. No pending-invite list/revoke, no ownership transfer, no delete-org (documented in-code as needing an `Invitation` model).
7. **Support**: tickets have subject/body/priority only — **no category/department**, and no attachment on the first message (replies get one, ≤10 MB). Customers can only write OPEN/CLOSED (validated at the boundary); read receipts flow staff→customer only.
8. **Chat agent** degrades honestly (`no_key`/`error`/`over_cap` → one warm hand-off message, never a blog snippet) and logs a real degradation for the operator. KB is Postgres FTS seeding a Claude agent (`lib/kb.ts`, `lib/kb-llm.ts`, `lib/kb-system.ts`).
9. **Activity**: `AuditLog.action` is free TEXT with no enum — I enumerated the literals. The gap is real and twofold: a hard 100-row cap with no paging/filter/export, and several security actions (`changePassword`, `signOutOtherSessions`, profile/SSH-key edits, gift redemption, ticket/feedback writes) that **write no audit row at all**. Impersonated rows show a raw `actingAdmin=<cuid>` in `detail` with no explanation.
10. **Three overlapping referral programs**: `/refer` and `/affiliate` are the same code and same reward presented twice (affiliate is an orphan route); `/partner` is separate lifetime-commission with UNIQUE-per-customer attribution and invoice-level idempotency. Affiliate tier amounts are marketing copy that can disagree with the actual credit, and lifetime earnings are totalled by **exact string match on a wallet-transaction description**.
11. **Notifications**: `Notification` has no kind/severity column; bell shows newest 15, opening it marks everything read, no history page, no per-item dismiss. Suppressibility policy in `lib/prefs.ts` is well-built (CRITICAL/ACCOUNT/PRODUCT, fails toward delivery).
12. **Largest single finding — ~20 email templates have no production sender**, including `server_suspended`, `server_terminated`, `password_changed`, `login_alert`, `low_balance` and `referral_reward`. Suspension, termination and every security change are classified CRITICAL in the policy yet reach the customer only as an in-app bell entry. Auth/gating itself is sound: browsing is open, buying is gated (`mayTransact`), impersonation blocks money and 2FA paths, and Kodely SSO validates `client_id` + redirect allowlist.
